reference_cases.reason: Exact candidates 001 through 025 have author generator/detector source-control evidence through declared smaller local HF bridges. The inventory records latest strict-library refusals and earlier below-threshold outputs with meaning changes, including separate frequency and indefinite-duration follow-ups. Other source states have not been rerun on each guard revision. Shared controls and duplicate source texts are not independent trials. Remaining source states are unexecuted. This is neither verified faithful removal, native vLLM/paper-model parity, calibrated FPR nor complete AutoMark/provider coverage.

Author detector replay over frozen synthetic source/control/output is available. A follow-up HF bridge used the author-size candidate budget and a preregistered local control threshold. Default rewriting refused the full source; experimental sentence rewriting retained the signal and changed meaning. The local length-conditioned controls do not calibrate human-text, native-provider or production FPR, and native vLLM generation is not covered.

Author Nomic response-dependent word selection and Paragram presence replay are available with pinned local assets and a declared CPU nonfused bridge. Initial small-model insertion failed its local contrast; a stronger local MLX insertion follow-up exceeded a predeclared diagnostic threshold on a frozen synthetic source. A default rewrite fell below that threshold but changed facts. A corrected-guard MLX rewrite retained the mark and did not establish complete fidelity. This is local research-owned-key evidence, with no calibrated production FPR, native paid-API generation or provider-removal claim.
Research-owned keys only; not OpenAI production verification.

Pinned selected-package author generator and detector ran on local synthetic text with research-owned keys. HF MPS float32 model logits feed unchanged CPU author processors; stochastic sampling is retained after passthrough steps. Text vocabulary compatibility was checked against the author-pinned tokenizer, with unsupported IDs forbidden. Independent detection confirmed the marked source and negative control; default strict library rewriting refused full output. This is not native vLLM/paper-model parity, production FPR calibration, provider-model watermark coverage or successful removal. Differently packaged submission candidates remain unexecuted. A pinned Qwen3.5-9B MLX follow-up returned full outputs, but both remained detected by fresh unchanged author detectors; returned output did not establish complete fidelity. This adds a remover-model experiment, not provider or differently packaged submission coverage.
